scholarship_exists.quote: The objective of the Scholarship is to identify and support outstanding Singaporean students (including Singapore Permanent Residents)
scholarship_exists.notes: Faculty-administered; covers tuition fees (excluding the MOE Tuition Grant) up to the amount payable by a Singaporean student, max 4 years; GPA >= 3.50 each semester; competitive. University-wide NUS scholarships (nus.edu.sg/oam/scholarships, incl. any for international students) could not be read (Incapsula).

scholarship_international.notes: Selection criteria for the School of Computing Scholarship list 'Singapore citizens or Permanent Residents': international students are not eligible for this award. Whether other NUS awards are open to internationals is unknown (OAM pages unreadable).
